subject: Announcement: Distance web pages back up

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Announcement: Distance web pages back up
parts:
The distance web pages (http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/)
are back online.

In updating the pages, I noticed that Distance 3.5 has been downloaded by more
than 1100 people in its first 10 months of life. Congratulations go to the
1000th registered user: Theia DeLong of the Institute of Marine Sciences at the
University of Southern Mississippi.



--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator
Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland KY16 9SS
